devdoc.author: BENQI Finance
devdoc.details: Dual oracle system with mechanisms for:      - Staleness detection      - Price deviation detection      - Automatic fallback between oracles      - Manual override to use only one oracle in case of compromise

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params._chainlinkOracle: Address of the Chainlink oracle contract
params._edgeOracle: Address of the Edge oracle contract

getFeeds(address).details: Reads feed addresses directly from the oracle contracts using the underlying token

params.qiToken: The qiToken to get feed addresses for

getUnderlyingPrice(address).details: Implements the fallback logic between Edge and Chainlink oracles

params.qiToken: The QiToken whose underlying asset price is being fetched

returns._0: The price of the underlying asset in USD, scaled to 18 decimals

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAssetOracles(address,address,address,.details: Configures both Edge and Chainlink oracles for a single asset

params.asset: The ERC20 token address to configure
params.customDeviationThreshold: Custom deviation threshold for this asset (0 = use default)
params.stalenessThreshold: Time in seconds before a price is considered stale

setDirectPrice(address,uint256,bool,bool.details: Only callable by owner, propagates the price to both oracles

params.asset: The asset address to set the price for
params.manualOverrideAllowed: If true, skips feed price deviation validation
params.price: The price to set (scaled to 18 decimals)
params.setInChainlink: Whether to set the price in the Chainlink oracle
params.setInEdge: Whether to set the price in the Edge oracle

setOracleMode(uint8).details: Only callable by owner, allows switching between dual mode and single oracle modes

setUnderlyingPrice(address,uint256,bool,.details: Only callable by owner, propagates the price to both oracles

params.manualOverrideAllowed: If true, skips feed price deviation validation
params.qiToken: The QiToken to set the underlying price for
params.setInChainlink: Whether to set the price in the Chainlink oracle
params.setInEdge: Whether to set the price in the Edge oracle
params.underlyingPriceMantissa: The price to set (scaled to 18 decimals)

params.newAdmin: The address to receive admin rights

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.
